# Calendar shiftOffset moves exception dates after the series setter moves recurrence IDs

A direct parent startDate change calls onStartDateChange, which moves exception recurrence IDs. shiftOffset then clones each exception and separately shifts its actual dates before modifyException. Paste and drag callers use this helper on cloned items. The test distinguishes an unchanged exception start date after a direct series change from a shifted exception date after shiftOffset. This is static source and unit-test intent; it does not establish a live clipboard, drag, time-zone or end-date result.

Scope: Calendar recurrence copy and move.
